description: Data for "Learning Limitations: Machine learning, value of information, and water distribution asset management is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Meghna Thomas, Takayuki Iguchi (Pacific Northwest National Laboratory). ANONYMIZED PIPE CONDITION ASSESSMENT DATASET============================================ An anonymized dataset of water distribution pipes used for a condition assessment study. Each row is a single pipe segment, paired with the condition rating recorded at its inspection. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
